# Vistance Networks to Release Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 5


October 15, 2026


Richardson, TX


[Vistance Networks](https://www.vistancenetworks.com/)


(NASDAQ: VISN), a global provider of intelligent network solutions,


plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, before the market opens. The release will be followed by an 8:30 a.m. Eastern conference call in which management will discuss the results.


The live, listen-only audio of the call will be available through a link on the


[Events and Presentations](https://ir.commscope.com/events-and-presentations) page of Vistance Networks’ Investor Relations website.


The webcast replay will be archived on Vistance Networks’ website for a limited time following the conference call.
